thoughts.sr: SEPA je prethodno u 4 minuta izveo 32 instrumenta, iako njihov poslednji označen čas završava u 06:00 UTC dok naš procenak pravih UTC-a iznosi 04:00; to znači da čas koji su tek poslali sadrži vrednosti od 04:00 do 05:00, a ne od 05:00 do 06:00 kao što je tvrdio Observer. PM10 u tom stvarnom času dostigao je 43 µg/m³ na Danijelovoj, ali NO2 je porastao od 8 do 57 µg/m³ bez odgovarajućeg pada maksimalne vrednosti PM10. [F2][F3][F4][F6]
thoughts.en: SEPA reported 32 instruments 4 min ago [F2], yet their last labelled hour ends 06:00 UTC while our estimate of true UTC is 04:00 [F3]; this means the hour they just sent contains values from 04:00 to 05:00, not 05:00 to 06:00 as Observer claimed. PM10 in that actual hour reached 43 µg/m³ at Danijelova [F4], but NO2 rose from 8 to 57 µg/m³ [F6] without a corresponding drop in PM10 maximum.
hypotheses: perhaps the city's air quality is worse than the modelled estimates suggest because the official stations report fewer values than citizen sensors [F10]
if the news-sorter estimate of 213 headlines [F38] is accurate, then local traffic incidents might be underreported compared to the 'radovi' category
questions: what does the record say about usual values at this hour for these stations [F43]
why did NO2 rise from 8 to 57 µg/m³ while PM10 dropped from 43 to a lower value in the same hour [F4], [F6]
hypotheses_sr: možda je kvalitet vazduha u gradu lošiji od onoga što modelirane procene sugerišu jer zvanične stanice izvode manje vrednosti nego građanski senzori
ako je procenak novinarskog sortera od 213 naslova tačan, onda lokalni saobraćajni incidenti mogu biti podizveštavani u poređenju sa kategorijom 'radovi'
questions_sr: šta kaže zapis o običnim vrednostima u ovom času za ove stanice
zašto je NO2 porastao od 8 do 57 µg/m³ dok je PM10 padao od 43 na nižu vrednost u istom satu
thoughts.next_check: verify if the city maximum of PM10 moved from 43 to a lower value between the hours 05:00 and 06:00 (source labels) [F5]

thoughts.sr: SEPA je prijavila 32 instrumenta pre 12 minuta, sa označenim satom koji završava u 06:00 UTC, dok naš procenjen pravi UTC iznosi 04:00. PM10 je porastao na 43 µg/m³ u Danijelovu iako je NO2 skočio od 8 do 57 µg/m³ bez odgovarajućeg pada u maksimumu. [F2][F3][F4][F7]
thoughts.en: SEPA reported 32 instruments 12 min ago [F2], with a labelled hour ending 06:00 UTC while our estimate of true UTC is 04:00 [F3]. PM10 rose to 43 µg/m³ at Danijelova [F4] despite NO2 surging from 8 to 57 µg/m³ without a corresponding drop in the maximum [F7].
hypotheses: maybe the NO2 surge at Banovo brdo indicates traffic acceleration that did not increase particulate loading in this hour
perhaps the lack of data from citizen sensors [F13] is masking a different pollution pattern than the official stations
questions: what time did the NO2 maximum actually occur if it rose so sharply?
did any station other than Danijelova exceed 41 µg/m³ for PM10 in this hour?
hypotheses_sr: možda skok NO2 u Banovo brdo ukazuje na ubrzanje saobraćaja koji nije povećao opterećenje česticama u ovom satu
možda nedostatak podataka od senzora građana maskira drugačiji obrazac onečišćenja nego što pokazuju zvanične stanice
questions_sr: u koje vreme je zapravo došlo do maksimuma NO2 ako je tako oštro porastao?
da li je neka stanica osim Danijelova premašila 41 µg/m³ za PM10 u ovom satu?

thoughts.sr: Poslednji označen čas SEPA završio je u 06:00 UTC, iako naš tačan procenat za UTC iznosi 04:00; PM10 je dosegao vrhunac od 43 µg/m³ na Danijelovu dok je NO2 skočio na 57 µg/m³ na Banovo brdo bez odgovarajućeg pada PM10. [F3][F4][F7][F6]
thoughts.en: SEPA's last labelled hour ended 06:00 UTC [F3], yet our true UTC estimate is 04:00 [F3]; PM10 peaked at 43 µg/m³ at Danijelova [F4] while NO2 surged to 57 µg/m³ at Banovo brdo [F7] without a matching drop in PM10 [F6].
hypotheses: perhaps the NO2 rise indicates traffic congestion that did not dissipate enough to lower PM10 before 06:00 UTC
if the surge in NO2 correlates with Banovo brdo's population density [F45], then emissions may have accumulated overnight
questions: what caused the sudden spike in NO2 if traffic patterns remained stable?
hypotheses_sr: možda porast NO2 ukazuje na gužve saobraćaja koje nisu bile dovoljno raspršene da smanje PM10 pre 06:00 UTC
ako skok NO2 korelira sa gustinom stanovništva Banovog brda, onda su emisije mogle da se nakupile preko noći
questions_sr: šta je izazvalo nagli skok NO2 ako su obrasci saobraćaja ostali stabilni?
thoughts.next_check: check if citizen sensors reported a correlation between vehicle count and NO2 levels after 06:00 UTC

da li nagli porast NO2 u Banovom brdu može biti povezan sa određenim događajem pomenutim u nedavnim naslovima?
